// @env node
import process from 'node:process'
import { defineCommand, option } from '@argvia/core'
import { runMain } from '@argvia/node'

const options = {
  mainClass: option.string({ flag: '--main' }),
  items: option.string({ flag: '--item', multiple: true }),
}

function command(action) {
  return defineCommand({
    options: action === 'init' ? { ...options, force: option.boolean({ default: false }) } : options,
    passthrough: true,
    run(context) {
      process.stdout.write(`${JSON.stringify({ action, ...context })}\n`)
    },
  })
}

const app = defineCommand({
  name: 'composition',
  defaultCommand: 'run',
  commands: { run: command('run'), plan: command('plan'), init: command('init') },
})

runMain(app).catch((error) => {
  console.error(error)
  process.exitCode = 1
})
